title: Advances in machine learning for wetland classification: a comprehensive survey of methods and applications
core_idea: Provide a comprehensive survey (2018–2025) of ML and DL approaches for wetland classification by critically reviewing key methodologies (CNNs, transformers, GANs), emphasizing underexplored techniques (few-shot learning, mamba networks), and offering practical recommendations to address challenges such as data scarcity, noisy labels, and model generalisability.
tldr: A focused survey of recent machine learning and deep learning methods for wetland classification that highlights main techniques, underexplored approaches, and actionable directions for handling limited data and improving generalisability.
